summary: A worker has to be at the meeting with the literature before the candidate gets there.
realLife: Peters recalled assigning volunteers to hand out material at Kennedy’s county appearances.
inGame: needs: a delivery assignment linked to the candidate's actual arrival at an appearance.

turns.what: The candidate arrives while the handouts are still across town.
turns.pulledBy: The stop moved forward after the delivery worker left headquarters.
turns.writesBack: The meeting opens without the printed material.

turns.what: The worker brings one box and leaves the rest for the next stop.
turns.pulledBy: The room is smaller than the original booking.
turns.writesBack: The stock count records the boxes still at headquarters.
